AQ2-2025.title: A scalable and real-time neural decoder for topological quantum codes
AQ2-2025.publisher: Senior et al. (Google DeepMind and Google Quantum AI) · arXiv:2512.07737
AQ2-2025.note: No journal reference on arXiv as of 15 November 2026. The abstract claims decoding faster than 1 µs per cycle on commercial accelerators, for the surface code up to distance 11. Read on 16 November 2026 from the arXiv HTML (v2) through a summarising fetch: the timing is on Trillium TPU accelerators; the figure comparing speed and accuracy uses simulated noise; no loop with a quantum chip is reported, and the discussion says the delay after the final measurement is not yet addressed. The methods section on how speed was measured was not read.
